The name is also associated with the belief that the bearer of this name will be a source of light and guidance, not just for herself but for her community as well.

It is believed that the name holds a deep connection to the divine, representing a bond between the individual and their creator. Layyah is a symbol of the innate light within each person, inviting them to illuminate their own path towards enlightenment and fulfillment. Additionally, the name is associated with the concept of ruh (spirit), representing the divine presence within an individual and reminding the bearer to keep their thoughts, words, and actions pleasing to Allah.
